verdict: PASS literal sequential transfer sweep and conditional checked-addition bound

validation.evidence: Parent confirmed targeted exit 0; independent exact-source and existing-log inspection, no reviewer build.
validation.axioms: All five printed exports standard propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound only

checks: sweep reads source balance from the current world on each recursion, then uses literal debit-then-credit ProtocolTransfer.transfer; no stale initial-world balance list.

current_balance ties the selected UInt256 amount to actual worldBalance. This proves each transfer funded by equality without any per-source funding assumption. Absent sources give zero; duplicate sources and recovery aliases are unrestricted.

ledger inductively supplies FundingHistory.Step.transfer and Ledger.conserving; p,w,s,c remain unchanged. The new Step constructor binds literal actual transfer and a funded gate; step_funds invokes proved ProtocolTransfer.funds. No arbitrary conserving-world postcondition is accepted.

funding threads the same source list and current worlds into FundingHistory.Trace with unchanged credits. frame composes the proved actual transfer frames, retaining protected code/existence/persistent storage.

recipient_add_bound reads recipient after debit, bounds that balance by the debited-world natural sum and adds the exact removed amount; this handles sender=recipient and yields a bound by pre-world funds.
checked_add_fits combines this derived bound with the explicit independent pre-world total < UInt256.size. No recipient-overflow postcondition or maximum-resulting-wealth assumption is used.
explicit_inputs: Arbitrary finite source list and recovery address; exact canonical DAO list is not established.
Existing actual Ledger or FundingHistory.Trace for the initial sweep world.
For checked_add_fits only: funded transfer amount and pre-world natural total < UInt256.size; funding history is the intended independent producer of the latter.
limitations: This closes the representation gap for literal conserving transfer sweeps in the extended ledger, but not reference apply_dao/state-tracker/state-diff correspondence.
The sweep credit index is unchanged; no unconditional exact total-funds equality is claimed when word credit could overflow.

The checked-addition lemma is per transfer. Propagating its pre-world bound through every sweep step is straightforward using funding nonincrease but not packaged here as a reference-equivalence theorem.
Zero transfers may materialize default accounts; account absence and reference touched/deleted-account details are not asserted preserved.
No canonical fork-selection, DAO recovery/source-list identity, external checked-U256 semantics or protocol funding closure.
